# Ultralytics YOLOv5-xs (no-SPP)

Object Detection · `yolov5-xs_512x512_nospp` · DX-APP C++ example

Object Detection model, evaluated on COCO.

**Input** 512 × 512 × 3 · **Dataset** COCO · **License** GPL-3.0 · **Quantization** Q-Lite, Q-Pro

## Quick start

Run from the dx_app root after `./install.sh` and `./build.sh`.

```bash
# from the dx_app root
./setup_sample_models.sh --models yolov5xs_wo_spp_512
```

**C++**

```bash
./build.sh --target yolov5-xs_512x512_nospp_sync   # once
./bin/yolov5-xs_512x512_nospp_sync \
  -m assets/models/yolov5-xs_512x512_nospp.dxnn \
  -i sample/img/sample_street.jpg
```

**Python**

```bash
python src/python_example/object_detection/yolov5/yolov5-xs_512x512_nospp/yolov5-xs_512x512_nospp_sync.py \
  --model assets/models/yolov5-xs_512x512_nospp.dxnn \
  --image sample/img/sample_street.jpg
```

## Accuracy

| Quantization | mAP |
|---|---:|
| Raw · ONNX | 32.88 |
| Q-Lite | 32.25 (−0.63) |
| Q-Pro | 32.47 (−0.41) |

COCO · difference vs Raw in brackets.
